rule: Every fifth stock from the 150 largest in the S&P 500 by market cap (positions 3, 8, 13 ... 148 in stockanalysis.com's S&P 500 list as read at 20:45 UK on 15 Oct 2026), chosen without looking at any stock's recent performance. If a stock's feed fails or has fewer than 400 sessions, the next position down takes its place and the swap is recorded here. Members are never changed for any other reason.
test: Primary measure: on every fifth session counted from 15 Oct 2026, rank the panel by the 48 price-only points and by the next five sessions' return minus the S&P 500's; average that rank correlation over the dates. Useful if the average is +0.03 or more with a t-statistic of 2 or more; harmful if -0.03 or less with t of -2 or less; otherwise no evidence. Judged separately for dates before 15 Oct (history) and from 15 Oct (live). Needs at least 8 dates.
source: Closes from the market data service (massive.com), split and dividend adjusted.
